scripts.build:character: tsc -p packages/operator-core/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/tool-runner/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/api-server/tsconfig.json
scripts.adobe:worker: npm run build --workspace @freeos/adobe-worker && npm run start --workspace @freeos/adobe-worker
scripts.animation:plan: npm run build --workspace @freeos/media-intelligence && npm run build --workspace @freeos/animation-core && node tools/scripts/animation-plan.js
scripts.test:adobe: npm run build --workspace @freeos/adobe-worker && npm run build --workspace @freeos/editing-core && node --test tools/tests/adobe.test.js tools/tests/adobe-worker.test.js
scripts.init:voice: npm run build --workspace @freeos/memory-core && npm run build --workspace @freeos/voice-core && node tools/scripts/init-voice.js
scripts.init:tools: npm run build --workspace @freeos/memory-core && npm run build --workspace @freeos/voice-core && npm run build --workspace @freeos/tool-runner && node tools/scripts/init-tools.js
scripts.research:status: npm run build --workspace @freeos/memory-core && npm run build --workspace @freeos/research-core && node tools/scripts/research-status.js
scripts.test:computer: npm run build --workspace @freeos/computer-core && npm run build --workspace @freeos/tool-runner && node --test tools/tests/computer.test.js
scripts.test:coding: npm run build --workspace @freeos/coding-core && npm run build --workspace @freeos/tool-runner && node --test tools/tests/coding.test.js
scripts.test:browser: npm run build --workspace @freeos/browser-core && npm run build --workspace @freeos/tool-runner && node --test tools/tests/browser.test.js
scripts.test:quality: npm run build --workspace @freeos/research-core && npm run build --workspace @freeos/api-server && node --test tools/tests/quality-execution.test.js
